title.narrative: Vietnam Improving Effectiveness and Sustainability of Social Health Insurance Expenditures

description.narrative: Development objective is to support the Government of Vietnam to strengthen institutional capacity for reforming provider payment mechanisms under the social health insurance scheme to better control its expenditurescomma align unit prices with costs and provide appropriate incentives for meeting public policy objectives of efficiencycomma equity and public health targets. The grant will support policy developmentcomma evidence generation and consensus building for applicable to Vietnam options for health insurance provider payment reform. It will help to mobilize relevant international expertise from countries in the region who are more advanced in implementing best practice provider payment reformscomma including in the areas of data requirements and information systems and quality assurance mechanismscomma classification systems for casescomma treatments and procedures and available cost informationcomma financial management mechanismscomma including credible underlying cost informationcomma financial and medical audits. It will support activities of a inter-agency working group including representatives from the MOH Departments of Health Insurancecomma Planning and Financecomma Social Security Administrationcomma Ministry of Laborcomma Invalids and Social Affairscomma relevant academic and research institutionscomma experts. It will finance international and national technical assistance and networkingcomma consultative and consensus building workshops. The project will also support institutional capacity strengthening thru training and one international study tour to a country with applicable experience. The project will be implemented by the Department of Health Insurancecomma Ministry of Health who will mobilize other relevant stakeholderscomma including Department of Planning and Financecomma Social Security Administration at central and selected subnational levels and locations.
